messages:
tanya: Quick note — planning a short maintenance in apac-edge (edge-sg1) tomorrow 00:30-01:30 SGT. TOR switch soft-reboot + NVMe micro-patch. We'll run micro-cohorts to avoid capacity cliffs.
josh: How big are cohorts? Any impact to hosted GPU capacity?
tanya: 3 hosts (~6 GPUs) per cohort, 8m gap. Target to keep hosted >=82%.
priya: Routing plan? Do we overflow to dedicated-burst or cross-region?
tanya: Primary fallback -> dedicated-burst for batch & embeddings. Chat stays on hosted unless p95>350ms. Snippet:
```
route apac-sg1 {
  prefer: hosted
  fallback: [dedicated-burst]
  match_by: request_type
}
```
josh: Cost estimate if 20% of traffic shifts to dedicated for 1h?
finance-bot: Estimated incremental spend ~$650 (approx, depends on reserved utilization).
priya: Ops checklist: canary cohort, monitor p95/p99, kv cache hit-rate, kvseed after each cohort.
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled: id=mtn-20250505-900 owner=tanya window=2025-05-05T00:30Z-01:30Z
tanya: Final comms at 23:45 SGT. Ping here for last-minute blockers. :rocket:
